id.description: The unique id of the guest. This is a `personId`

subject.description: The external unique identifier of the guest.

displayName.description: The guest’s display name shown in Webex applications

email.description: The person’s synthetic email in Webex.

accessToken.description: The guests access token. Guest tokens usually are over 2000 characters in length.

expiresIn.description: The token expiration in seconds from the time of issuance.
